stage_a.name: fixed_height_orientation_mechanism_necessary_bound
stage_a.hypothesis: Any independently placed supporting feet accepted by original IK and the inherited shaft envelope can satisfy all additional losses.
premises: Original hips, yaw ranges, body height/orientation, COM and uncertainty; supporting ankle plane unchanged.
For each swing, additionally lose one same-side support, leaving one support on that side and all three opposite-side feet.
Original yaw ranges place every opposite-side foot at or beyond its hip side.
Hip-to-foot distance plus inherited 40 mm allowance cannot exceed the original 400 mm shaft load arm.
Force and moment balance plus unilateral normal forces and 300 N cap remain mandatory.
stage_a.formula: H=abs(hip_y); R=sqrt((shaft_arm-0.04)^2-(hip_height-ankle_height)^2); Y=abs(com_y)+dy+(com_z-ankle_height)*tan(5deg); W=mass*load_factor*g*cos(5deg); Nsole >= W*(Y+H)/(2*H+R). For mirrored case use the outward COM corner and slope.
controls: Cross-check bound using separate 4-normal-force LP at favorable relaxed positions.
Zero COM uncertainty and flat slope relax the bound and must not falsely close the family.
Altered hip/yaw/height premises reject reuse of this certificate.
stage_a.stop_rule: If the validated necessary bound exceeds the frozen cap, close only this fixed-height/orientation planar-ankle family. Do not score independent-foot or body-path candidates inside that impossible family; record their searches as unexecuted by gate.

stage_b.name: baseline_common_body_translation_regions
stage_b.purpose: Diagnostic necessary regions, never a static admission shortcut.
stage_b.construction: For every five-foot baseline stance intersect all five capped-normal-load centroid polygons and ordinary 40 mm inset support polygons over all four COM corners and all nine gravity vectors. Variables are common body x/y translation; feet remain fixed in a reference world frame. Leg torque and kinematic dependence on body pose are deliberately omitted from this outer region.
stage_b.quantifier: One pre-loss body translation for all possible extra losses; forces may differ.
outputs: halfspaces tagged by loss, slope and constraint
Chebyshev center and inradius or checked numerical infeasibility certificate
per-loss feasibility separately to expose wrong-quantifier acceptance
all six phases and original sampled positions
stage_b.algorithm: Normalized halfspaces; HiGHS LP maximizing signed common slack in meters; explicit primal residual check; if slack < 0, verify nonnegative dual combination cancelling body x/y with negative combined bound.
